input.command:
L=layers/cart/app; mkdir -p $L/components $L/composables $L/middleware $L/utils
git mv app/components/cart $L/components/cart
git mv app/composables/useCart.ts app/composables/useCartTotal.ts app/composables/useDiscount.ts $L/composables/
git mv app/middleware/cart-not-empty.ts $L/middleware/
git mv app/utils/discount.ts $L/utils/
echo 'export default defineNuxtConfig({
  components: { dirs: [] },
})' > layers/cart/nuxt.config.ts
P='#layers/cart/app'
grep -rlE "~/(components/cart|composables/use(Cart|CartTotal|Discount)|utils/discount)" app layers | xargs sed -i '' -E \
 -e "s#~/components/cart/#$P/components/cart/#" \
 -e "s#~/composables/(useCart|useCartTotal|useDiscount)'#$P/composables/\1'#" \
 -e "s#~/utils/discount'#$P/utils/discount'#"
git diff | grep '^[+-]' | grep -v '^+++\|^---' | head -50
npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -15; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
